_meta.purpose: CoachTurnPacket: the assembled truth of ONE coach turn — every fact the reply may use, from one place (finding H-03). Ratified LAST and most carefully, because it assembles from the other seven canonical contracts: it is keyed by the InteractionTrace turn_id and embeds the AthleteContext, the WorkoutSession, the ExerciseIdentity list in play, the CoachingDecision, the SafetyDecision, and (on a closeout turn) the CloseoutTransaction. Read-only, pure; NOT yet wired. Phase 3 assembles it in shadow for every real turn; Phase 4 makes the live coach route consume it, retiring route-local recomputation of packet-owned facts.
_meta.grounding: Every embedded fact is validated by its OWN canonical contract's validator (services/athleteContext.js, workoutSession.js, exerciseIdentity.js, coachingDecision.js, safetyDecision.js, closeoutTransaction.js) — the packet is valid iff each embedded fact is canonical, so 'one Brain' is a schema invariant, not a convention. There is no single home to adapt from (facts are recomputed route-locally today), so there is no boundary adapter; the packet IS the assembly.
_meta.consistency_note: The single safety verdict must be represented consistently: when both `safety` (SafetyDecision) and `decision` (CoachingDecision) are present, `safety.state` must equal `decision.safety.level` and `safety.blocking` must equal `decision.safety.blocking` — the route and the Brain read one verdict, they do not each re-derive it (H-12). `exercises` is the ExerciseIdentity list resolved for the turn (may be empty). `turn_id` is the InteractionTrace turn id (the single id spanning the whole turn).
